name: Spectral warp modes: vocode, formant scale, harmonic stretch, smear
goal: Add WT spectral/formant morph delta beyond basic wavetable-position pads: use spectral warp modes—vocode (key-tracked formant shift, vocal/vocoder character), formant scale (more exaggerated vowel/formant moves without key-tracking), harmonic stretch (even harmonic expansion; great for LFO→acid/sci-fi), inharmonic stretch (metallic/bell chaos), and smear (spectral high-pass / additive smear from bottom of table)—then modulate the warp amount for evolving cinematic texture.

source.title: The ULTIMATE Guide To Master Vital - Spectral Warp Modes

prerequisites: Wavetable synth with spectral/formant warp or equivalent (vocode/formant/stretch/smear-like) oscillator effects; LFO/mod matrix

inputs.name: modulate
inputs.description: Whether to LFO/envelope the warp amount

outputs.name: spectral_morph_osc
outputs.description: WT osc with chosen spectral warp + optional motion

constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided Show-transcript text; do not invent UI paths or numeric settings not stated there.
Original synthesis / signal-flow only — map brand UI to portable osc/filter/env/LFO/FX modules for Traveler-inspired or Web Audio hybrid; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Prefer transferable parameter relationships over vendor-specific preset or bank names.
Not affiliated with the plugin/hardware vendors named in the source video; recreate with comparable modules.
Delta vs ambient-wavetable-scratch-spectral-morph-pad / digital-wt-morph: focuses on named spectral warp mode behaviors (vocode/formant/stretch/smear), not building a WT from scratch or FX bus.

steps.action: Load a rich wavetable (complex/harmonic content). Open oscillator spectral warp / formant-style effect slot.
steps.expect: Warp control audible on static table

steps.action: Try vocode: shifts formants in a key-tracked way so formant character stays steadier across notes — good for vocal/vocoder-ish WT pads and text-to-speech tables without wild pitch-of-formant jumps.

Compare formant scale: moves harmonics/formants more exaggeratedly than vocode while keeping relative harmonic structure, but without the same key-tracking steadiness — stronger vowel changes, more note-to-note timbre shift.
steps.expect: Bigger formant sweeps; less locked across keys

steps.action: Use harmonic stretch for even, patterned spectral expansion; modulate with LFO for spacey acid / high sci-fi alarm motion. Switch to inharmonic stretch for uneven metallic/bell/crystal textures and aggressive growls.

Use smear as a spectral high-pass / additive smear: table starts at the bottom of the control and spreads harmonics upward until the sound thins/smears out (Razor/Harmor-like). Good for whippy high-pass spectral gestures.
For cinematic pads: pick one warp mode, set modest amount, LFO or envelope the warp (and optionally WT position); follow with filter → chorus → delay → reverb. Avoid stacking every mode at once.
steps.expect: Evolving spectral pad without chaotic overload

verification: Vocode vs formant-scale difference is audible across notes
Harmonic stretch stays more tonal than inharmonic stretch
Smear thins/high-passes spectrally when amount rises
